title: Thunderbird App Keeps Crashing
creator: jumorga1
content:
Hi,

I use Thunderbird for Android, version 24.0. It downloads emails and attachments just fine, but whenever I try to use it for more than about three minutes, it will crash and say "Thunderbird is not responding", and I get sent back to the main screen.

I have Android version 16, One UI 8.5. How can I share my logs with you? Thanks.

--Justin M.
